title: 块大小与寻址：NameNode 元数据量估算
expected_output:
size=1MB blocks=1 namenode_meta_bytes=150
size=128MB blocks=1 namenode_meta_bytes=150
size=300MB blocks=3 namenode_meta_bytes=450
size=1024MB blocks=8 namenode_meta_bytes=1200
code:
BLOCK = 128 * 1024 * 1024
META = 150  # 每文件/块约 150 字节元数据
def analyze(size_mb):
    nb = (size_mb * 1024 * 1024 + BLOCK - 1) // BLOCK
    return nb, nb * META
for size_mb in [1, 128, 300, 1024]:
    nb, meta = analyze(size_mb)
    print("size={0}MB blocks={1} namenode_meta_bytes={2}".format(size_mb, nb, meta))
